title: Sequence Drop Text Labels Fixes
description: Fix destructive reload in Sequence WASM host (replace_fixture, next_serial), canonicalize fixture JSON comparison in React, give text module into-scope-write parity with math/logic, extend is_function_kind for text.*, update TS catalogue.
summary:
Fixed three reported Sequence playground issues at the root.

1. Destructive reload: added SequenceHost::replace_fixture with monotonic next_serial from fixture ids, collision-safe next_step_id/next_edge_id, and wired WASM loadFixtureJson to replace in place instead of rebuilding the host (which reset next_serial to 100 and caused duplicate step-101 ids on second drop).

2. React fixture round-trip: canonicalize fixture JSON via parseSequenceFixtureJson/sequenceFixtureToJson before comparing session vs prop, avoiding spurious reloads from Rust 40.0 vs JS 40 formatting.

3. Text module parity: text.concat/uppercase/length now write results into scope via an into key (matching math/logic); TS catalogue exposes into in inspector; is_function_kind includes text.* so text steps render data ports with hidden flow pins.

Tests: cargo test sequence_core (13), imperative_module_text (4), imperative_engine (6); wasm rebuild; vitest sequence-core, sequence-react, sequence-play, imperative-core all pass.
